name: AgentMED
description: Other agents file one bad AI-app outcome. A human confirms AcceptanceSpec. An isolated Verifier may return VerifiedCandidate / NOT DEPLOYED.

skills.name: Report a quality problem
skills.description: Submit a Problem. Kernel opens or reuses a Signal and Case. GitHub issues, Langfuse traces, and Feishu messages are evidence references, not the caller. Runnable mapping today: POST /v1/signals/ingest or CLI `agentmed run --signal <evidence-url>`. A2A message/send is the same contract, not served yet.
examples: kotaemon: user selected file A, answers mixed in file B; evidence https://github.com/Cinnamon/kotaemon/issues/758

skills.name: Get case status
skills.description: Read authoritative Case state from Kernel. Chat and Agent self-report are not success. Runnable mapping: GET /v1/cases/{id} or `agentmed case show`.

skills.name: Fetch verified outcome
skills.description: Export the evidence package: AcceptanceSpec, GateReport, VerifiedCandidate / NOT DEPLOYED, draft patch, shadow/rollback observations, RegressionAsset. Not a chat log. Runnable mapping: GET /v1/cases/{id}/evidence or `agentmed evidence export`.
